questions.statement: In “This involves paying careful attention to language, while also developing a critical awareness of the relationships between texts, images, discourse conventions and sociocultural and digital contexts”, select the correct alternative regarding the highlighted term “careful”.

options.text: The word “careful” is formed by adding the suffix “-ful” to the noun “care”, resulting in an adjective that expresses the absence of attention or caution.
“Careful” is an adjective derived from the verb “care” and the prefix “ful-”, indicating an intensified action.
The word “careful” contains the noun “care” and the suffix “-ful”, forming an adjective that denotes the presence of caution, attention, or concern.
“Careful” is a compound word formed by two free morphemes, “care” and “full”, and functions as a noun referring to someone who cares a lot.
The suffix “-ful” in “careful” has no impact on the word’s meaning, serving only a phonological purpose in this context.

questions.explanation: A palavra careful resulta da base care acrescida do sufixo derivacional -ful, formando adjetivo que indica cuidado ou atenção. O sufixo não significa ausência, não é prefixo e altera classe e sentido; careful também não é substantivo composto de care e full.

questions.statement: The following extract, Text 2, comes from the introductory paragraph of the article: In fact, reading could actually make you a _____, _____ person. It also makes you act in a _____ acceptable manner. The alternative with the sequence of words that accurately completes the extract is

options.text: kindest / most empathetic / socially Matemática e Raciocínio Lógico

questions.explanation: O comparativo de “kind” é “kinder”; o de “empathetic” constrói-se com “more”. Já “socially” é advérbio e modifica “acceptable”. As demais combinações confundem comparativo com superlativo ou usam adjetivo onde se exige advérbio.
